nodes.name: FileLoadMixin._start_a2l_load
nodes.func: changed A1. Preserve admission, recents, busy and sync decisions. examples: (R-A2L-REFRESH.030/1) empty session with A2L generation `0` and image generation `0` → request expects A2L generation `1`, image generation `0`, image mapping `None`; frozen request rejects writes

(R-A2L-REFRESH.030/2) IMG1 with `0x1000: 0x10`, expected A2L generation `3` and unchanged image generation `7`; then source address 0x1000 changes to 0xFF → request retains `0x1000: 0x10`, map size `3`, and rejects mapping writes

(R-A2L-REFRESH.033/6) `1000000` image bytes and keys `tab` then `shift+tab` queued immediately before request capture → both existing actions acknowledge before worker completion, each latency at most `1.0` s, and the worker receives an independent read-only copy
(R-A2L-REFRESH.034/4) `1000000` image bytes during request capture → existing busy line remains visible, every visible progress gap is at most `1.0` s, and no timer freeze or bar regression occurs

nodes.name: FileLoadMixin._a2l_attach_worker
nodes.func: changed A2. Inside the existing copy/parse Exception boundary, retain the selected path, parsed entry and parse timing, then call A3 after parsing with keyword-only a2l_path=path, a2l_data=entry[1], image_mem_map=request.image_mem_map, expected_a2l_generation=request.expected_a2l_generation and expected_image_generation=request.expected_image_generation. Construct one A6 from request, path, entry, parse_seconds and the returned A7 before dispatching the existing deferred install callback. Any preparation exception returns through the existing attach-failure callback; no result or partial snapshot is dispatched. Self is limited to existing logger, progress and thread-dispatch infrastructure.

nodes.name: FileLoadMixin._prepare_a2l_attach_snapshot
nodes.func: new A3, route-neutral; all five inputs after self are keyword-only. On the worker, use a2l_path only as explicit parsed-source context and call the existing enrichment/summary service once with a2l_data and image_mem_map. Derive the enrichment key from the explicit expected pair and mem_size=-1 for None or len(image_mem_map), then derive measurable names using the existing address/name rules. Call describe_definitions independently once for Check and once for Patch over that same full name sequence; pack A7 and both A8 entries with a2l_source=a2l_data, signature=enrichment_key and read-only containers. Read no request, admission state, widget, mounted state, current session or live generation.
examples: (R-A2L-REFRESH.029/1) typed parsed NEW with `ARR12` length `12` and `u16` → one A7; enrichment `1`, summary `1`, Check describe `1`, Patch describe `1`, all off UI before install, and visible NEW cells are exact
(R-A2L-REFRESH.029/2) existing workarea NEW with copy `False` → the same complete off-UI A7 before install, copy calls `0`, and no OLD cell survives
(R-A2L-REFRESH.029/3) start-up load_path `new.a2l` → complete off-UI A7 before start-up install and outcome, with no component deferred to manual refresh

(R-A2L-REFRESH.030/1) no-image parsed OLD at `old.a2l` with explicit expected pair `1`, `0` and image_mem_map `None` → one frozen A7 with enriched-tag tuple, summary tuple and read-only check/patch mapping; field, tuple and mapping writes all fail and worker UI/session reads are `0`

(R-A2L-REFRESH.030/3) static census resolves worker/helper nodes `2` → forbidden widget/session reads `0`; one synthetic self.current_file read is detected once, while logger, progress-forwarder and thread-dispatch calls remain visible
(R-A2L-REFRESH.033/3) real enrichment held off UI and keys `tab`, `shift+tab` → both acknowledgements occur during enrichment, each at most `1.0` s, before install or outcome

(R-A2L-REFRESH.033/4) first real bulk describe held off UI and keys `tab`, `shift+tab` → both acknowledgements occur during definition preparation, each at most `1.0` s, and neither picker paints a partial generation

(R-A2L-REFRESH.034/1) enrichment held off UI for `1.5` s → existing busy line stays visible, at least `2` spinner/elapsed changes occur, every measured gap is at most `1.0` s, and no outcome appears during the hold

(R-A2L-REFRESH.034/2) bulk definitions held off UI for `1.5` s independently → existing busy line stays visible, at least `2` spinner/elapsed changes occur, every gap is at most `1.0` s, and no outcome appears during the hold

(R-A2L-REFRESH.037/1) OLD measurable names `ARR12`, `AUX2` with lengths `12`, `2` and `u16` → one all-names Check describe and one independent all-names Patch describe, both off UI before population; each A8 contains both definitions and UI describes `0`

(R-A2L-REFRESH.037/2) same-path NEW changes ARR12 to length `8` and `f32` → exactly one additional describe per picker for the new generation, distinct Check/Patch A8 entries, and no OLD `u16` definition or shared single-call shortcut

nodes.name: FileLoadMixin._install_attached_a2l
nodes.func: changed A4 on UI. For a product result, first compare A7's pair with current A2L+1 and unchanged current image before recents, files refresh, cache, session, dependent-view or project-sync mutation. A mismatch directly ends busy with the exact superseded text and returns. A match preserves existing install order, uses _replace_current_a2l, attaches the same parsed payload to the unchanged image, installs enrichment key/tags/summary with summary start 0 and _accepted_a2l_picker_snapshots, then runs exactly one existing common refresh and the existing outcome tail. Legacy A6 preparation None retains only the direct-construction compatibility path.
examples: (R-A2L-REFRESH.031/1) empty session generations `0`, `0` and matching OLD result → installed key has A2L generation `1`, image generation `0`, mem_size `-1`; OLD_SCALAR shows size `2` and `u16` coherently before refresh

(R-A2L-REFRESH.031/2) A2L generation `1`, image generation `3`, IMG1 size `3` and matching OLD result → installed key is A2L generation `2`, image generation `3`, mem_size `3`; image identity and `0x1000: 0x10` remain and OLD cells match IMG1

(R-A2L-REFRESH.031/3) IMG1 plus OLD at `same.a2l`, generations `2`, `3`, map size `3`; overwrite with NEW → installed key is A2L generation `3`, image generation `3`, mem_size `3`; source and snapshot show ARR12 length `8`, `f32`, image bytes stay unchanged and OLD `u16` does not survive

(R-A2L-REFRESH.032/1) live generations A2L `5`, image `2`, but NEW A7 records A2L `5` instead of expected `6` → `Load superseded — current state kept.`; OLD/IMG1/MAC state and views stay exact, with `0` recent, cache, session, install, common-refresh, sync or success mutations

(R-A2L-REFRESH.032/2) live generations A2L `5`, image `2`, but NEW A7 records image `1` instead of expected `2` → `Load superseded — current state kept.`; no NEW enrichment, picker definition or fallback recompute reaches a view, and every install-side effect count is `0`
(R-A2L-REFRESH.035/1) first accepted `old.a2l` → exactly `install → common refresh(UI) → A2L loaded: old.a2l`, common-refresh count `1`, no manual refresh, and current OLD everywhere at outcome

(R-A2L-REFRESH.035/2) accepted OLD→NEW replacement → exactly `install → common refresh(UI) → A2L loaded: new.a2l`, common-refresh count `1`, and neither an OLD value nor an intermediate empty state is painted at outcome

(R-A2L-REFRESH.035/3) active one-A2L project, same-path OLD→NEW and modal answer Yes → one normal worker and one UI common refresh after complete NEW installation, before success; sync_project `False` and project bytes unchanged

(R-A2L-REFRESH.036/1) OLD without image → worker enrichment construction `1`, worker summary construction `1`, UI constructions `0`; common refresh consumes the installed tags/summary and paints OLD size `2`, `u16` and no-image values

(R-A2L-REFRESH.036/2) OLD over IMG1 → worker enrichment construction `1`, worker summary construction `1`, UI constructions `0`; the exact three-part key hits the installed caches and paints IMG1-backed OLD cells

nodes.func: changed P1. Equal non-None signature returns False before consuming prepared input. Otherwise preserve row normalization, page, filter and pick behavior. A supplied read-only mapping, including empty, is installed as definitions with its a2l_data source and zero describes; omitted input preserves the existing one bulk direct describe. Definitions and definitions_source always describe the last real population.

nodes.name: CheckEditorPanel.set_a2l_parameters
nodes.func: changed C1 on UI. Before app access, an unmounted panel keeps legacy a2l_data None and omitted prepared definitions, reads or invalidates no accepted mapping and preserves its identity. A mounted adapter selects only the check A8 from the app's accepted read-only mapping. Pass its prepared definitions to P1 only when key, A2L-source identity and full signature match. On any present-entry mismatch, first replace the whole accepted mapping with an empty read-only mapping, then use the existing route describe. Preserve no-op, document, selection, demotion, layout and preview side effects.

entities.name: [Data: A2L busy run]
entities.desc: Existing main-thread busy spinner, elapsed field, byte progress and outcome. Post-parse preparation leaves the completed parse-byte bar unchanged while spinner/elapsed continue. Progress transitions and the terminal outcome are not installation of an A2L result.

entities.name: [I/O: workarea A2L copy]
entities.desc: Existing worker copy. A copy produced before stale preflight or preparation failure is not installed session state and is never project-synced by that rejected result. Preparation failure still routes through the existing Workarea Files refresh when copy=True and the new copy may appear in that list.

entities.name: [Data: Current A2L]
entities.desc: Current path, parsed payload and A2L generation owned by _replace_current_a2l; preflight also reads the unchanged live image generation before this entity changes.

entities.name: [Data: A2L view caches]
entities.desc: Exact three-part enrichment key, enriched tags, summary lines and summary start. A4 installs all of them after current-A2L replacement and before common refresh; the unchanged cache consumer sees the key and performs no UI enrichment or summary construction.

entities.name: [Data: Picker population]
entities.desc: Shared picker rows, read-only definitions, A2L source, signature, filter, page and picks. Equal non-None signature is a no-op before prepared-input consumption; a real population consumes one supplied map without describing.

entities.name: [Data: Check picker population]
entities.desc: Check adapter's embedded picker and existing document, selection, demotion, layout and preview behavior. Only a matching check snapshot supplies prepared definitions.

entities.name: [Data: Patch picker population]
entities.desc: Patch adapter's embedded picker and existing selection and layout behavior. Only a matching patch snapshot supplies prepared definitions.

entities.name: [Data: A2L attach request]
entities.desc: A5 immutable request with expected post-install pair and request-owned read-only image copy; the worker's only application input apart from existing logger/progress/thread infrastructure.

entities.name: [Data: A2L attach result]
entities.desc: A6 immutable parse result. Product success always carries one complete A7; preparation None is limited to legacy direct construction and is never worker-isolation evidence.

entities.name: [Data: A2L attach snapshot]
entities.desc: A7 complete generation-bound worker hand-off of enrichment, summary and independent Check/Patch A8 entries. It is built before result dispatch and installed coherently or discarded whole.

entities.name: [Data: A2L picker snapshot]
entities.desc: A8 literal check or patch key, full enrichment signature, exact A2L source object and that picker's read-only bulk definitions. Parser and Definition payloads remain read-only after hand-off.

entities.name: [Data: Accepted A2L picker snapshots]
entities.desc: The app's _accepted_a2l_picker_snapshots, always a MappingProxyType when present. A4 replaces it before common refresh. Unmounted adapters read neither app nor this mapping and leave its identity intact for a later matching mount. Mounted adapters use an empty read-only default when absent; any present-entry generation/signature/source/key mismatch replaces the whole mapping with empty before fallback.

findings.title: cache container types use the integrated installation rule
findings.seen: Static source reads show list-typed app caches, while the frozen hand-off requires tuples and the four-file slice excludes app/core.py.
findings.cause: Direct tuple assignment would drift the existing cache attribute types; rebuilding enrichment would violate .036.
findings.effect: The installation rule preserves cache types without recomputation or another source file.
findings.decision: ACCEPTED/INTEGRATED. A4 performs one shallow list conversion per tag/summary tuple, resets summary start to 0, installs the picker mapping as-is and then reuses those caches.

findings.title: the accepted mapping uses the integrated absent-attribute default
findings.seen: app/core.py is outside the counted slice, so no new initializer may be added there; non-direct routes can run before the first direct attach.
findings.cause: First-use absence needs a read-only default that does not expand the source slice.
findings.effect: The default avoids an unguarded attribute read and preserves the existing route when a key is absent.
findings.decision: ACCEPTED/INTEGRATED. Both adapters read absence as empty MappingProxyType; A4 replaces the mapping and a present-entry mismatch empties it before fallback.

findings.title: A7 is the integrated preflight authority
findings.seen: I-ALP-2.1 and I-ALP-2.2 carry the expected pair in both request and snapshot; integrated I-ALP-2.4 selects the snapshot pair for preflight.
findings.cause: Direct A2 maps the request values into route-neutral A3, which returns the same pair in A7.
findings.effect: .032 mutations and implementation have one explicit target and cannot confuse the two carriers.
findings.decision: ACCEPTED/INTEGRATED. A4 preflights A7's pair and both .032 examples mutate that pair; preparation None remains legacy-only.

findings.title: busy progress and outcome are integrated control transitions
findings.seen: The unchanged callback paints existing step 3 before A4 preflight; .032 requires previous-state preservation and an exact outcome while .034 requires continuous progress.
findings.cause: Busy step/progress and terminal outcome control the existing run; they do not install A2L result data into dependent views.
findings.effect: The accepted reading preserves progress/outcome without weakening preflight's ban on install-side mutation or expanding the counted slice.
findings.decision: ACCEPTED/INTEGRATED. Preflight precedes recents, files, cache, session, project sync and dependent-view installation/refresh; busy progress and the mandated outcome remain control transitions.

findings.title: baseline extraction confirms static seams but not dynamic callbacks
findings.seen: Baseline-only extraction found 6 marks, 6 nodes, 3 real calls, 0 findings and 0 parse failures; it reported 55 name-based ambiguities and cannot see callbacks passed as values.
findings.cause: Check/Patch homonyms and call_from_thread/call_after_refresh are outside precise name-based call resolution.
findings.effect: The extraction alone cannot prove the worker-to-install order or distinguish the two adapters' callers.
findings.decision: Retain E1's direct callback census and make the dynamic order explicit in entity sequences. No runtime defect or functional result is claimed.

findings.title: unmounted adapters preserve legacy input and accepted snapshots
findings.seen: The existing headless caller constructs an unmounted panel and calls set_a2l_parameters; eager app/mapping access would break its legacy a2l_data None behavior and could invalidate a snapshot before mount.
findings.cause: Snapshot selection must be guarded by is_mounted before any self.app or mapping access.
findings.effect: Unmounted Check and Patch calls retain omitted prepared input and a2l_data None, perform zero mapping reads/writes and preserve snapshot identity; a later matching mount reuses it.
findings.decision: ACCEPTED/CORRECTED in both adapter nodes, their .037/5 examples and the accepted-mapping sequences; no SOURCE or describe-count change.

findings.title: preparation failure retains Workarea Files refresh
findings.seen: The existing failure handler refreshes Workarea Files for a copying request and a new copy may consequently be listed.
findings.cause: Preservation of every current view would incorrectly suppress an unrelated existing file-list obligation.
findings.effect: Failure preserves the current image and A2L-dependent state/views while retaining the existing file-list refresh.
findings.decision: ACCEPTED/CORRECTED in .038, its three examples and the workarea preparation_failure sequence; no common refresh, install, sync or success is added.

findings.title: E3 alternative and collected-item counts
findings.seen: Adding one .037/5 alternative to each adapter adds two example links but no node, entity, edge or SOURCE file.
findings.cause: The requirement ledger has 34 alternatives and 3 ATs, while the graph has 45 node-example links.
findings.effect: Planned collected items total 37; graph structure remains 7 nodes, 12 entities, 20 edges and 4 SOURCE files.
findings.decision: ACCEPTED/CORRECTED in E1/E2 validators and reports. Trace TEST granularity remains per requirement ID.
